answer: A concrete approach: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The river of work and the marble of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a wander to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
